---
title: "Lightbox: nothing qualifies"
# bd-kcpkgftw. With no `lightbox` option and no `.lightbox` image, the
# runtime is not shipped at all (Q1 only adds the dependency when an image
# was actually wrapped).
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'img[alt="Beach in Chilmark"]'
        - - 'a.lightbox'
          - 'script[src$="glightbox/glightbox.min.js"]'
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - - '.figure>\s*.img src="images/mv-0\.png"'
        - ["GLightbox", "glightbox\\.min"]
---

![Beach in Chilmark](images/mv-0.png)
